payload.abstract: This project contains head movement data recorded from groups of participants asked to stand as still as possible and presented with a series of auditory stimuli. Data was collected in units of mm with a Qualisys motion capture system at 100Hz. Data was collected at the University of Oslo on March 12th 2015 from a total of 108 participants. Code to read and process these files has been made publicly available.

payload.short_description: How and why does music make us move? This project investigates how music influences small magnitude motion observed when people try to stand still.
payload.title: MICRO Motion capture data from groups of participants standing still to auditory stimuli (2015)
